Recommendations

Range error is -46.3% — tune MPC guidance gains or verify thrust curve
High in-flight AoA — consider lowering qp_solver_cond_N further or reducing N_horizon
Pitch oscillation in terminal phase — check damping gains and actuator bandwidth
Fins saturating — likely MPC solve timeouts produce suboptimal controls; check qp_solver_cond_N is set (should be ~10, not None)
Servo tracking MAE=3.55° exceeds 2.0° limit — check fin mechanical play, servo_auto_zero calibration, CAN bus speed
⚠ SERVO DELAY: Set RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY = 0.360s (measured 320ms + 40ms overhead, min 100ms). This gives lookahead_stage=18.
